comment: Written BEFORE any code reads INCLUDES (the W discipline). v0.33 answers Central's item 4 (stzzui's S5: four seats and 40 of 60 constraints written ten times) and S14. INCLUDES [form] on a DECLARATION; ON a FORM, and a quantifier (some, all, earlier, exists) over a FORM, expand over the kinds that include it. All of it is sugar the meta-court resolves: the court never sees it, which the guard proves by forging the hand-expanded twin and comparing the courts byte for byte. A1-A8 accept (A7 and A8 pin that no existing reading changes); R1-R13 refuse, each by the fragment of why. R6, R7 and R9 keep refusals the language already spoke.

accepts.name: INCLUDES: two kinds take the seats of a FORM, and the declarations are two
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE medium AS (VERSION "0.33", GRAMMAR "0.33", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".medium") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU intents AS (WORDS [confirm, cancel, zoom, read], CODE "UNKNOWN_INTENT") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM guarantees AS (SEATS [satisfies: [intents]?, always_reachable: [intents]?, actor: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION screen AS (VERB "SCREEN", INCLUDES [guarantees], SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION vibe AS (VERB "VIBE", INCLUDES [guarantees], SEATS [density: name?]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: all, exists and earlier over a FORM
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE medium AS (VERSION "0.33", GRAMMAR "0.33", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".medium") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU intents AS (WORDS [confirm, cancel, zoom, read], CODE "UNKNOWN_INTENT") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM guarantees AS (SEATS [satisfies: [intents]?, always_reachable: [intents]?, actor: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION screen AS (VERB "SCREEN", INCLUDES [guarantees], SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION vibe AS (VERB "VIBE", INCLUDES [guarantees], SEATS [density: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c1 AS (ON vibe, WHEN "not (all guarantees where actor present)", MESSAGE "m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c2 AS (ON vibe, WHEN "exists guarantees", MESSAGE "m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c3 AS (ON vibe, WHEN "earlier guarantees where actor present", MESSAGE "m") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: an existing reading never changes: a seat of the kind named like a FORM stays that seat, so `tag present` reads the quantified declaration's seat
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE medium AS (VERSION "0.33", GRAMMAR "0.33", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".medium") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU intents AS (WORDS [confirm, cancel, zoom, read], CODE "UNKNOWN_INTENT") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM guarantees AS (SEATS [satisfies: [intents]?, always_reachable: [intents]?, actor: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [tag: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION screen AS (VERB "SCREEN", INCLUDES [guarantees], SEATS [guarantees: [step]?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT c AS (ON screen, WHEN "some guarantees where tag present", MESSAGE "m") RATIONALE "x"
